files.content:
# Pixel Kanban Board

A fully offline, pixel-art themed kanban board with To do, Doing, and Done columns.

## Features

- Add cards to the To do column
- Move cards left or right using arrow buttons (disabled at ends)
- Delete cards with confirmation
- Live count per column
- Keyboard accessible (labeled buttons, Enter to add)
- Responsive layout from 360px wide

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or network required.

## Files

- `index.html` – main page
- `styles.css` – pixel-art styling
- `script.js` – application logic
